svg.title: Context and training change different things
svg.desc: On the left, a rubric, examples and evidence are supplied with a new case in a prompt to an unchanged LLM. On the right, reviewed excerpt-label pairs train a LoRA adapter while the base LLM's weights stay fixed. The saved adapter is used with the matching base LLM to process new cases; context can still be supplied. Both save responses and are compared on the same held-out test cases.
svg.text: Compare on the same held-out test cases
